column1: # Fields the update-manifest SHAPE REFERENCE declares but this build does not publish.
# docs/design/client-update-manifest.example.json is the shape the ADR and three
# code files point implementers at, so it describes the FULL eventual manifest —
# including delivery fields that do not exist yet. `update-manifest-shape-guard.sh`
# requires every such field to be listed here with the reason it is withheld, so a
# field can never sit in the published contract with no owner and no explanation.
# An entry covers the path itself and everything nested under it.
# Format: <path><TAB><why it is not published yet>
# Removing an entry is how a field graduates: emit it from
# client/scripts/update_manifest.gd and the guard requires the row to go.

column2: Nothing consumes it. Ordering is by `sequence`, deliberately clock-free (cd.yaml: a clock is the right source for an expiry and the wrong one for an ordering), and `not_after` is already the one clock fact the manifest needs.

There is no pack. CD builds a macOS .app ZIP, not a mountable cumulative .pck; recording that ZIP here would let recovery hand an application archive to the pack-mount path. Waits on the pack pipeline (ADR child 3).
Same missing pack pipeline as pack.full — there is no base artifact to compute a delta against.
A shell replacement must be authorized by the offline root, carried in shell_authorization. That root does not exist, so any download offered here would be an unauthorized shell replacement.
The offline root that would sign a shell download does not exist yet (ADR child 6).
No production signing key, custody or certificate publisher exists yet (ADR child 6, tracked by #490).
No revocation publisher or revocation-head endpoint exists yet (ADR child 6, tracked by #490).
Nothing signs the manifest yet. The published OCI artifact IS cosign-signed by digest, which is a real but different integrity property.

No mountable content pack is retained yet, so the array ships empty and its element fields are unreachable. Empty is the fail-closed value: UpdateDecision refuses a capability-raising pack rather than shipping one no player could roll back from.
